scenes.dialogue: Hello. If you are an advocate, this video is for you. I am Ravishankar, founder of LawWorld. I want you to watch it carefully, as it could change the way you practice law.
It can make your work better, faster and cheaper. Let me introduce LawWorld, India's newest and most powerful AI platform for advocates. LawWorld has more than fifteen features.
Each one is built to help you in a different area of your daily legal practice. For case preparation, you get an AI chatbot, drafting tools, legal research and translation.
Everything you need is ready in one place. You also get a complete database of judgments, acts, rules and regulations. All your legal data resources are together, on one platform.
A library of thousands of e-books and videos supports your research. It also helps you grow your knowledge, every single day.
Slides gives you ready-made presentations on law content. Use them to teach, to train your juniors, or to explain a point of law with clarity.
Law Stories brings you high-quality audio discussions on legal topics. Listen and learn on the move, while travelling or waiting at court.
Both Slides and Law Stories are available in more than ten Indian regional languages. So you can learn and teach in the language you think in.
For client management, you get team chat, client billing and a client portal. Your clients stay informed and your office stays organised.
The Your Cases feature connects to e-courts. You can track every case, hearing and order without checking many websites each day.
The Argument Presenter helps you present your case in court. You no longer need to carry heavy physical files to every hearing.
LawWorld is a highly secured platform, fully compliant with the DPDP Act. Your client data stays private, protected and in your control.
LawWorld works on the web, on Android and on iOS. So you can work from your office or on the move.
Don't worry if you're new to AI. Our training videos show you how to use every feature — basic computer skills are enough to get started.
We offer two simple ways to pay. With Pay-as-you-go there is no monthly fee, so you pay only for what you use.
The Pro plan costs just fifteen hundred rupees per month, or twelve thousand rupees for the whole year, plus GST.
It covers most of your needs, and you pay extra only for add-ons and AI usage.
